"""Train the account churn probability model."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import joblib
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

from .features import FEATURE_ORDER, build_features


def fit_model(df: pd.DataFrame):
    model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=500))
    model.fit(build_features(df)[FEATURE_ORDER].to_numpy(), df["churned"].to_numpy())
    return model


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--data", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    model = fit_model(pd.read_csv(args.data))
    Path(args.out).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    joblib.dump(model, args.out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Write batch churn probabilities keyed by customer ID."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import joblib
import pandas as pd

from .features import FEATURE_ORDER, build_features


def predict_frame(df: pd.DataFrame, model) -> pd.DataFrame:
    scores = model.predict_proba(build_features(df)[FEATURE_ORDER].to_numpy())[:, 1]
    return pd.DataFrame({"customer_id": df["customer_id"].to_numpy(), "score": scores})


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--model", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--input", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = predict_frame(pd.read_csv(args.input), joblib.load(args.model))
    Path(args.out).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output.to_csv(args.out, index=False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Online scoring entrypoint for account records."""

import pandas as pd

from .features import build_features

SERVING_ORDER = [
    "tenure_months", "monthly_charge", "support_calls", "late_payments",
    "contract_monthly", "auto_pay", "internet_fiber", "paperless",
]


def score_request(payload: dict, model) -> float:
    frame = build_features(pd.DataFrame([payload]))
    row = frame[SERVING_ORDER].to_numpy()
    return float(model.predict_proba(row)[0, 1])

"""Shared numeric representation of customer accounts."""

import pandas as pd

FEATURE_ORDER = [
    "monthly_charge", "tenure_months", "support_calls", "late_payments",
    "contract_monthly", "auto_pay", "internet_fiber", "paperless", "usage_gb",
]


def build_features(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    values = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    for name in ("monthly_charge", "tenure_months", "support_calls", "late_payments",
                 "auto_pay", "paperless", "usage_gb"):
        values[name] = pd.to_numeric(df[name], errors="raise")
    values["contract_monthly"] = (df["contract_type"] == "monthly").astype(float)
    values["internet_fiber"] = (df["internet_service"] == "fiber").astype(float)
    return values[FEATURE_ORDER].astype(float)
